sloka: जातमात्रं तु सुश्रोणी पितुर्हस्ते न्यवेशयत् ।बुधस्य समवर्णभमिला पुत्रं महाबलम् ।। ७.८९.२४ ॥
transliteration: jātamātraṁ tu suśroṇī piturhaste nyaveśayat ।budhasya samavarṇabhamilā putraṁ mahābalam ।। 7.89.24 ॥

translations.english: As soon as the very powerful son, who resembled Budha in complexion, was born, Ila of beautiful hips placed him in his father Budha's hand.
